articles.title: How US-China RISC-V collaboration is deepening despite chip rivalry
articles.summary: The collaboration between US intellectual property provider MIPS and Chinese firms in advancing the open-source RISC-V chip architecture signifies a remarkable breakthrough in cross-border cooperation, underscoring that innovation can thrive even amidst escalating tech tensions between the US and China. This partnership not only accelerates the global adoption of RISC-V but also challenges the notion that geopolitical rivalries can stifle technological progress.
